p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Restoration of WWOX function by neuron-directed replacement, read as a set of separate endpoint families, none of which stands for the others.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: In the Wwox-null mouse, one laboratory: survival to 300 days at the higher level and postponed death at the lower; body weight equal only at P30 (low dose lags earlier); glucose partial and age-dependent; motor score graded; gliosis binary against wild type; myelination unquantified in treated arms. All of it is PREVENTED or EARLY-WINDOW; astrogliosis at P5 injection is back to wild type (S8I); myelin is unquantified in the treated arms.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Constitutive null, not Q230P; one laboratory (the two papers share senior author and institution); no replication; earliest postnatal treatment ages only and NOT_MEASURED is not SMALLER; no tumour surveillance or overexpression-toxicity endpoint; SWD recorded over one week starting about two weeks after birth; threshold not located. Every endpoint is measured after neonatal treatment (P0 to P5) in animals that were never measured before treatment: the result is PREVENTION or EARLY-WINDOW, not recovery of a manifested deficit. No treated-after-onset arm exists; the authors state later intervention 'was not explored' and that this reflects 'model-specific biological constraints and technical limitations, rather than a definitive boundary'. S8A: the P3 arm (n=3) falls to about 67 percent from about day 24; the P5 arm is at 75 percent from about day 35 to day 300 (n=7, S8B); the main text says that treatment at any time point between P0 and P5 fully rescues, which is not what S8A/S8B show; S8 has no P0 arm and no P4 survival curve, and compares treated arms against wild type, so 'ns' is not equivalence.

cellular_context.target_expression: Neuron-directed construct; WWOX protein graded by vector level and regionally uneven, supraphysiological in survivors and survivor-selected (PREMISE: NOBODY_LOOKED on the upper bound).
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Mouse brain regions; the cerebellum, the organ of the ataxic phenotype, is the region the vector reaches least and no efficacy endpoint was measured there; protein also reaches the sciatic nerve while liver stays at background.
cellular_context.coverage: Oligodendrocyte-directed construct produced essentially no detectable protein, so the oligodendrocyte question is unanswered, not answered negatively.
cellular_context.limits: Residual partial function in a missense context is a reason to expect a DIFFERENT result, not a larger one; the expected level of rescue in the reference genotype does not follow from this study in either direction.

input.axis: C / restoration of WWOX expression: endpoint families of the dose study

mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Gene addition is allele-blind (Track A) and aims at the lost function itself. In a missense context with residual partial function a DIFFERENT result is expected, not a larger one: the expected level of rescue in the reference genotype does not follow from this null-mouse study in either direction. Several endpoint families here are partial, non-graded or unquantified.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_card.identity: AAV9-hSynI-WWOX in the dose study (WPRE-free), as in card P4-C-01. This card carries the endpoint families other than the spike-wave discharge row (which lives in P4-C-01 and is linked beside this card): survival, body weight, glucose, composite motor score, gliosis and myelination, each with its untreated or wild-type comparator and its limit. No vector quantity is reproduced; map record R-01.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE (all genotypes carry some level of WWOX deficit) as target; origin: a constitutive-null mouse and human knockout and patient-derived organoids. Transfer to a Q230P-class missense or compound context is not established.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied (two mouse papers, one laboratory). A gene-therapy programme for WOREE is recorded at grant level (census § 3); that is not a registered study.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: partial: the only measured rescue in the corpus, complete on several R-class endpoints, with no S, C or D datum.
p4_card.expected_contribution: Early-window restoration by replacement (early-window benefit demonstrated in the null mouse; recovery after onset not tested); nothing is stated for clinical benefit.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: WWOX gene dosage in neurons; type: replacement; direction: protein up; context: null mouse brain.

internal: CLAIM 002, CLAIM 004, CLAIM 011 (flagged for review, NOT consolidated), CLAIM 040, TX-007, DL-MOL-005, DIS-021, DIS-023
sources.note: Here the sources ARE WWOX evidence in the null mouse; the transfer to the reference genotype is the gap.

for: SWD to a level not distinguishable from wild type in the strongest causal design of the corpus (blinded; single vector level).
Durable survival to 300 days at the higher vector level, comparable to the wild-type arm (which itself lost about 29 percent).
Graded WWOX protein, glycaemia at one age and motor score.
against: Not independently replicated within the repository; the source's mouse-versus-human construct comparison is an intra-study control, and the human-organoid source was not tested here.

SURVIVAL IS A STEP IN THESE DATA, BUT A STEP AND A STEEP CONTINUUM ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE: the lower level postpones death and reaches extinction; two dose points cannot locate a threshold; the adjudication in CLAIM 011 reads the step as strengthened, not established.
Body weight is equal at the two levels at P30 only and the weight comparison is survivor-conditioned on the lower side: an equality between unequal denominators is not evidence of grading.
Myelination dose relation never quantified; gliosis result binary against wild type with no untreated-null comparator; SWD has no low-level arm.
No tumour surveillance of any kind in a pro-apoptotic tumour suppressor delivered irreversibly; no measured ceiling.
Treatment age window tested only at the earliest postnatal ages; later NOT_MEASURED.
Behaviour at 3 months has no untreated-null arm by construction and a text-versus-panel conflict, not adjudicated.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Null versus missense or compound context; mouse absence-type SWD versus human convulsive repertoire.

p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. The census records a programme with a gene-therapy objective at grant level; no registered WOREE study; sponsor-declared authorisation, enrolment and first dose UNKNOWN.
p4_card.time_to_benefit: UNKNOWN in humans. In the mouse the SWD effect was recorded over one week starting about two weeks after birth; no earlier ECoG timepoint exists.
p4_card.pharmacology: Not applicable in the small-molecule sense: biodistribution regionally uneven; potency, selectivity and CNS exposure of a human product: UNKNOWN. The absolute vector quantity is uncertain by exactly a factor of two in the source and no figure is reproduced.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: One laboratory; no replication; support is intra-study.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Values are those bound in woree_rescue_reference_scaffold.md section 2 and in manifest PMID42422765.json; entries 40, 41, 10, 14, 15 and 45 carry adverse blind-audit findings that were repaired at source and whose repairs have not been re-judged; entries 27, 6, 43, 36, 37, 9, 44, 47 carry none.
scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: The choice to write the low-dose survival and weight rows with the same sign as the high-dose rows (a sign comparison) and to name them a postponement and an equality at one age is the card's reading and is owed a blind audit by another actor.

question_history: CLAIM 011 flag of 2026-08-10 (dose-dependent over a threshold) -> NARROW adjudication CC-20261021-SCIENTIST-C-CLAIM011-DOSE-ADJUDICATION-01
p4_card.next_measurement: An intermediate-level arm, defined as a fraction of the primary's higher level (never in absolute quantity), carried to 300 days with survival, weight, glucose, ECoG and quantified myelin and gliosis with an untreated-knockout arm in the same panel; and an independent replication.
p4_card.status_reason: Transfer to the reference genotype not established; no replication; several endpoint families are not dose-graded or not quantified.
p4_card.value_added: Puts the study's other endpoint families into assertion rows, with the comparator actually run, so the join reads them and so a partial or non-graded endpoint is not collapsed into 'rescue'. The prose of P4-C-01 held them only as text.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

not_known: Whether a missense or compound context with partial residual function would respond more, less or differently.
The upper bound of safe expression and any tumour risk.
Whether treatment after the earliest postnatal ages helps less, equally or more.
The shape of the dose relation between the two tested vector levels.
Whether the source's result is reproduced by an independent laboratory.
Whether the endpoints that are not dose-graded (weight, glucose at postnatal day 10 and 30, gliosis, myelination) would separate with an intermediate level.
Cognition: no cognitive endpoint is measured anywhere in the study; behaviour at three months has no untreated-null arm by construction.

Whether an oligodendrocyte-directed construct that produces measurable WWOX protein would add to a neuronal one: the MBP-promoter arm produced no benefit and essentially no detectable protein (entry 45; repaired adverse audit), so the question is unanswered, not answered negatively.
evidence_against: Survival: a step and a steep continuum are indistinguishable; threshold not located.
No replication within the repository (two papers, one senior author and institution); the human-organoid AAV9-WWOX source was not tested for this claim.
Body weight is equal at the two levels at P30 only (the low dose lags P15-P25) and survivor-conditioned on the low-dose side (entry 41, repaired adverse audit not re-judged).
Glucose at postnatal day 10 is not significantly corrected by either level against the untreated knockout (the text says partially); the dose separation at day 20 is gone by day 30.
Gliosis: the two quantified treated-arm panels have no untreated-knockout comparator and the low dose is significantly worse than wild type on astrocyte area.
Myelination of the treated arms is never quantified.
bridge_gaps_exposed: The bridge compares signs on equal target, endpoint and context. Low-dose rows share the sign of the high-dose rows on survival and weight; the difference (postponement, equality at one age, survivor conditioning) is in the assertion notes, not in any summary field.

Where the treated-arm panel has no untreated-knockout arm (glucose at day 20, gliosis area, myelination) the direction is written UNKNOWN: the comparison is against wild type only and the bridge cannot express that.
Dose is not a context dimension: low-dose and high-dose rows differ only in their ids and notes.
